structured_concepts.short_explanation: How parent applications spawn child processes and pass down environment variables and configuration contexts.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: If environment variables or credential manager paths differ between the host shell and spawned child processes, external agent CLIs will fail to authenticate or access state.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: On Windows, differences between native Windows, PowerShell, and WSL environments cause credential mismatches that break CLI conversation continuity.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Translating raw CLI and process error output into actionable user-facing troubleshooting advice.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: Clear diagnostics guide users to resolve local environment or authentication discrepancies quickly.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Helps detect when Windows credential manager or profile configuration issues occur and instructs users on proper re-authentication.
